## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Windows x86 build and tests pass.
- [ ] Runtime tests, if performed, list the EXE version, resolution, mode and observed results.
- [ ] Known limitations and remaining manual tests are documented.
- [ ] No original game binaries, assets or saves are included.

Compilation and static analysis are not gameplay tests. Mark experimental changes
as drafts. A release requires the repository owner's explicit approval.
